responsibility: Implements the gm2 generic `WORD` stack as a linked chain of fixed-capacity buckets. It handles allocation, push/pop, top-relative lookup, bulk shrinking, and underflow diagnostics, and is the standard storage primitive used throughout the front end for symbol IDs, parser state, remembered types, and other word-sized control data.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the word-stack pair: it defines the bucket-based `WORD` stack representation and implements push/pop, peeking, reduction, `RemoveTop`, counting, and underflow diagnostics. Unlike `M2StackWord.def`, it contains the concrete mechanics of the word-valued stack.
